text:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-inference queue growth detected for model 'redwood/open-large-v2' across us-west-2. Autoscaler flagged max node limit reached for gpu-pool-inference-1. Current queue length: ~18k requests. Throttling and 429s increasing. Paging on-call now.

ryan-sre: I'm oncall. Thanks. Paging @ana-oncall for handoff, will start triage. What region/zone and pool are we seeing saturation on?

ana-oncall: seeing it in us-west-2a/b. Pool: gpu-pool-inference-1 (mixed A100p/40GB). Autoscaler status: "at maxSize". maxSize configured in k8s autoscaler = 48 nodes. Current nodes = 48. Pending pods stuck in Pending (InsufficientGPU / scheduling constraints).

ryan-sre: can you paste `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending` and describe one?

ana-oncall: paste logs:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending
inference-gen-7d8f5 Pending 0/1 0 10m
inference-gen-7f2c1 Pending 0/1 0 9m
inference-gen-9a1bd Pending 0/1 0 8m

$ kubectl describe pod inference-gen-7d8f5 -n inference
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning FailedScheduling  9m  default-scheduler  0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
```

john-infra: confirmed autoscaler maxSize=48 from the cluster config. There's also a hard cap at the cloud quota for GPUs in the project which we've set as a safety to prevent runaway costs. Current GPU quota for us-west-2 is 60, but pool-level max was set to 48 during last cost review. We can temporarily raise pool max to 60 to allow immediate scale. Note: adding nodes will take ~4–6 minutes per instance group resize.

ana-oncall: customers are seeing higher 429s and latencies now. Maria, any direct customer tickets tying back to this?

maria-cs: yes — CS-1324 (fintech customer) started reporting increased error rates 18 minutes ago. SLA risk for two customers on dedicated tiers. They're getting throttled rather than waiting — they rely on low tail latency.

ryan-sre: proposed mitigation plan: 1) manual pool max bump from 48 -> 60, 2) enable short-term burst mode (if available) on pool to allow quicker node provisioning, 3) relax non-critical pod anti-affinity to allow packing, 4) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for non-enterprise routes. Approval from infra lead required for quota bump.

ops-lead: proceed with manual bump. Keep changes minimal and revert after traffic normalizes. Coordinate with billing and infra.

john-infra: I'll perform the manual change in the infra console and kick off resize. Steps:
- Console -> Clusters -> gpu-pool-inference-1 -> Edit autoscaler
- Increase max nodes: 48 -> 60
- Save -> Trigger resize on MNG (managed instance group)
Or run gcloud command:
```
$ gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize gpu-inference-mig --size=60 --zone=us-west2-a
```
I'll do console change + gcloud to speed it up.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Terraform drift detected for cluster autoscaler maxSize if modified outside IaC. Please coordinate with infra for a post-incident patch.

john-infra: making change now. ETA for first new node join ~5 minutes. Will post join events.

ana-oncall: while nodes start, can we relax pod anti-affinity on low-priority batches? That could free up slots quicker.

ryan-sre: go ahead, but tag the change with `incident/2050012345` and set a 2-hour automatic revert. Use the `inference-low-priority` toleration for temporary scheduling.

john-infra: nodes are provisioning. I see instance-xxx starting -> kubelet registering.

deploy-bot: scale action completed: cluster autoscaler maxSize set to 60 by john-infra. Managed instance group resize in progress.

john-infra: 2 nodes joined us-west2-a, 3 in us-west2-b so far. Current nodes: 53/60.

ana-oncall: Pending pods are scheduling now. Queue length down to ~7.2k, ingress 429s decreasing.

maria-cs: CS-1324 reporting errors decreased. They confirm requests are flowing again. Will keep watching for a few hours and update customers.

ryan-sre: monitoring metrics: per-token latency tail improving, QPS still elevated but backlog draining. I'm keeping an eye on hot-spots; enabling fallback routing to model-lite for public traffic now.

ops-lead: good. Reminder: we need a postmortem: root cause investigation (why queue spiked, why autoscaler hit a configured ceiling). Also action item to evaluate autoscaler policy vs business traffic profiles.

ana-oncall: quick recap for customers: immediate fix = manual pool max bump + anti-affinity relax + fallback routing. Impact window ~30 min. No data loss.

john-infra: follow-ups: 1) open infra ticket to update terraform and request quota increase with cloud ops if needed; 2) add autoscaler alert for approaching 80% of max nodes (preemptive); 3) evaluate faster node boot images for burst workloads.

maria-cs: I'll coordinate customer comms and mark impacted accounts. CS will ask for credits per SLA if needed.

ryan-sre: closing the operational loop: queue now at 1.1k and draining, 429s back to baseline. Leaving the pool max at 60 for now but will revert to policy after postmortem. Thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: manual-capacity-unlock applied by john-infra. Duration: 00:47. Actions: manual node bump, anti-affinity relax, fallback routing. Postmortem owner: ryan-sre. Link to follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2050012345

ryan-sre: assigning postmortem. I'll owner and schedule blameless review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Action items in the doc.

ops-lead: great work. :thumbsup!
